```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"There are currently 44 million uninsured Americans, an increase of one million for each of the past eight years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Hospitals in the poorest urban and rural areas are being callously closed by the current administration, while the administration budgets far less than was originally projected, while calling for greater coverage.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Recent reports estimate that almost 100,000 patients die each year from medical errors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The number of deaths from medical errors each year is more than from auto accidents, murders, or AIDS.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Medicare pays for only 53 percent of seniors' care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Medicare does not cover outpatient prescription drugs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Medicare does not cover real long-term care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Medicare is headed for bankruptcy in the near future.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Medicare is suffocating under more than 130,000 pages of federal rules.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The number of pages of federal rules governing Medicare is three times the size of the entire IRS code.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The doctor-patient relationship has been eroded and, in some instances, replaced by external decision-making and managed care bureaucracy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
